subject: Coffee & Tea
title: Absorption and Half-Life
description: A micro-lesson that makes Absorption and Half-Life usable.

hook.text: Caffeine is absorbed incredibly fast—99% of it enters your bloodstream within 45 minutes of drinking.

buildup.text: Peak blood levels hit around 1 hour. Then the liver starts breaking caffeine down using the enzyme CYP1A2.

discovery.text: Caffeine's half-life averages 5–6 hours. Half the caffeine from your 3 PM coffee is still in your brain at 9 PM.

twist.text: Genetics vary this dramatically. Some people clear caffeine in 2 hours; others take 10. Same dose, different experience.

climax.text: Smoking doubles caffeine clearance speed. Pregnancy doubles the half-life. Oral contraceptives slow it further.

punchline.text: Same cup, different bodies, wildly different effects. Genes decide.

quiz.question: What is caffeine's average half-life in the body?
